## Draghul (CR 12)

**XP** 19,200  
 Adult white dragon ghul creature  
 CE Large undead (cold)  
 **Init** +5; **Senses** dragon senses, snow vision; Perception +22; **Aura** cold (5 ft., 1d6 cold damage), frightful presence (180 ft., DC 17)  

**Defense**

 **AC** 27, touch 10, flat-footed 26 (+1 Dex, +17 natural, –1 size)  
 **hp** 162 (13d12+78)  
 **Fort** +13, **Ref** +9, **Will** +10  
 **DR** 5/magic; **Immune** cold, paralysis, sleep, undead traits; **SR** 21  
 **Weaknesses** vulnerability to fire  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft., burrow 30 ft., fly 200 ft. (poor), swim 60 ft.  
 **Melee** bite +20 (2d6+10/19–20 plus paralysis), 2 claws +19 (1d8+7 plus paralysis), 2 wings +14 (1d6+3 plus paralysis), tail slap +14 (1d8+10 plus paralysis)  
 **Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 5 ft. (10 ft. with bite)  
 **Special Attacks** breath weapon (40-ft. cone, DC 21, 12d4 cold), exhalation of death (60-ft. cone, DC 21), paralysis (DC 21)  

 **Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 13th)  

 At will—fog cloud, gust of wind  

 **Spells Known** (CL 1st)  

 1st (4/day)—mage armor, *[shield](../../magic/spells/shield.md)*  
0-level (at will)—dancing lights, detect magic, ray of frost, mending  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 25, **Dex** 12, **Con** 21, **Int** 12, **Wis** 15, **Cha** 12  
 **Base Atk** +13; **CMB** +21; **CMD** 32 (36 vs. trip)  
 **Feats** Alertness, Flyby Attack, Improved Critical (bite), Improved Initiative, Vital Strike, Weapon Focus (bite), [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Toughness.*  
 **Skills** Fly +11, Intimidate +17, Knowledge (arcana) +17, Perception +22, Spellcraft +17, Stealth +13, Swim +31  
 **Languages** Common, Draconic  
 **SQ** icewalking, ice shape  

**Special Abilities**

 **Cold Aura (Su)** An adult white dragon radiates an aura of cold. All creatures within 5 feet of the dragon take 1d6 points of cold damage at the beginning of the dragon’s turn.  

 **Ice Shape (Su)** An adult white dragon can shape ice and snow at will. This ability functions as *stone shape*, but only targeting ice and snow, not stone. The caster level for this effect is equal to its Hit Dice (13).  

 **Icewalking (Ex)** This ability works like the *spider climb* spell, but the surfaces the dragon climbs must be icy. The dragon can move across icy surfaces without penalty and does not need to make Acrobatics checks to run or charge on ice.  

 **Snow Vision (Ex)** A white dragon learns to see perfectly well in snowy conditions. A white dragon does not suffer any penalties to Perception checks while in snow.
